Overview of Nidwalden Region (Nidwalden)

Nidwalden Region (Nidwalden) is located in the Nidwalden region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Stans. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionNidwalden
Capital cityStans
Cities & municipalities6
Primary transport hubStans Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Nidwalden Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Nidwalden

When visiting cities across Nidwalden, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Nidwalden

Best time to visit Nidwalden: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
